The State Of Chinese AI

Arthur Kroeber, Laila Khawaja

Gavekal Technologies: Briefing | 19 Oct 2026

The AI world suffered tremors last week, as doubts began to surface about the frontier labs’ revenue growth and the rising amount of high-priced debt used to finance the US’s data center building binge. The risks raise a question: when and if the American AI bubble pops, can China race ahead? Probably not. China’s AI ecosystem is impressive and evolving fast. But it is not positioned to overtake the US any time soon, even if American labs and hyperscalers hit serious speed bumps. This note assesses four features of China’s AI industry: the open-weight ecosystem, data, electricity and talent. China has strengths in all areas, but is mostly still playing catch-up.Also in this issue of China Tech Brief:
